CustomField.description: Prevent D&B data from being associated with Billing and operational accounts. This formula field should evaluate the Account's record type. If the Account's record type is either "Billing Account" or "Operational Account", the formula field should evaluate to TRUE (checked). For all other Account record types, the formula field should evaluate to FALSE (unchecked).
CustomField.formula: IF(ISPICKVAL(IM_Hierarchy_Level__c, 'Operational Account'),true, IF( ISPICKVAL(IM_Hierarchy_Level__c, 'Billing Account'), true,IF( ISPICKVAL(IM_Hierarchy_Level__c, ''), true, false)))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Prevent D&B data from being associated with Billing and operational accounts.
CustomField.label: Exclude from D&B Connect
